tx.note: every transaction included in a block (num_txs), successful or failed. Injective order-book trades settle in the end blocker; transaction-level transfers are deposits, sends and contract calls, and block-level settlement is in transfers.block_level.

transfers.method: sampled-blocks (transaction-level bank transfer events of successful transactions, fee legs removed; amount = net per transaction and denom, gross_amount = every leg)

block_level.method: sampled-blocks (finalize/begin/end-block transfer events, staking, inflation and fee plumbing removed; netted per block)
